free_tier.stated: 1 TB of cloud block storage plus one cloud server worth up to $100, 30 days, 20+ locations.

retention.stated: 30 days, then auto-converts to paid at standard rates

egress.terms: Includes 5 TB outbound transfer (1 TB in Asia and Australia), followed by metered overage rates.

record.tooling: Root KVM + block volume; SSH/SFTP/rsync, so rclone sftp. The block volume can be attached and served over any protocol you install.
record.chaining: Single trial per customer and the page is explicit that the $1–$2 card authorisation is the gate that limits repeated signups. Not repeatable without new cards.
record.limits_note: 30 days, then auto-converts to paid at standard rates. Config must fit inside $100. Card verification charge $1–$2.
record.reliability_note: Reseller-grade infrastructure (20+ DCs, KVM); trial endpoints are commonly rate-limited or suspended for sustained outbound. No data-vanishing reports found, but no long-run evidence either.

evidence.proved: 'The following is included in the free trial: 1 cloud server valued up to $100 … 1 TB of cloud block storage … 5 TB of outgoing Internet traffic (1 TB in Asia and Australia)'
same page — 'a charge of $1 to $2 is initiated to verify the validity of your credit card … Your service type will change from trial to paid when it ends.'
